record.name: Supabase
record.one_liner: An open-source Firebase alternative providing a Postgres database, Authentication, Instant APIs, Edge Functions, and Storage.
record.access_note: Developers can sign up for a free plan and obtain API keys and access tokens immediately via the dashboard.
record.api_note: The Management API and Data APIs cover projects, organizations, databases, auth, and storage comprehensively.
